section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1998
title: ACCIDENTAL DEATHS & SUICIDES IN INDIA - 1998 N.C.R.B., (M.H.A) 1.1.3 Out of 2,58,409 accidental deaths, 2,35,647 (91.2%) deaths were caused by un-natural causes. Only 22,762 (8.8%) deaths were caused by natural causes. As compared to 1997, there was significant increase (20.4%) in deaths due to natural causes as against an increase of 9.6 percent in these deaths due to un-natural causes.
